title: Degree bound for odd coefficients
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $a$ assign a real coefficient to each subset of $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. Suppose $a(S)=0$ whenever $|S|>k+1$. Define coefficients on subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ by assigning to $S$ the coefficient of the subset formed by adjoining position $0$ to the positions obtained by shifting every element of $S$ up by one. These new coefficients vanish whenever $|S|>k$.
hypotheses_covered: Coefficient function a from subsets of Fin (n+1) to ℝ
